$comment: M-321 second pre-registration, no-number-rules round (batch 2026-10-29-aa), committed alone before the change it covers and in addition to prereg-nn.json (73abac61). It covers the operator ruling given after that file was committed, recorded as part of CHAT-198.NN-Q4: "We should use the building footprint or 6M as the default." Rule text: "The front setback from averaging reads the user's neighbour setbacks, then the building-footprint estimate flagged needs survey, then a 6.0 m default flagged as a default; a missing neighbour figure never stops the calculation." Change: resolveFrontAveraging (scripts/analysis/bylaw/front-averaging.mjs) answers 6.0 m with basis default_6_0 and default_used true where averaging may apply and no user figure or usable estimate exists (the M-256 undecided case, which returned the owed answer); the max-build scenarios then evaluate. Scorer effect: NONE. The scorer reads user figures from the plan facts only; it does not promote the estimate or the default, so every row stays in its class and the expected moves and totals below equal those of prereg-nn.json (all other registrations of that file stand, including the four DIFFER findings and the rule that no floor may fall). Verified before this file was committed by running the scorer on the 172 set and the cumulative set with the change in the working tree: 0 rows differ from the run registered by prereg-nn.json. Product tests (red first) cover the three-step value order and the max-build evaluation.
